lede: Mark finishes Week 4 four clear. Brian's free point turned into a 45-24 rout and pulled him level with Jon and Patrick on nine — a three-way tie for second.

beats.text: Atlanta owns both sidelines of his Monday night game, so the point was his either way — but they won it 45-24 with Bijan Robinson running for 145 and Brian Robinson scoring three times. Only the second time in Falcons history two players have each run in multiple touchdowns. His worst team in September is now his best story.

beats.tag: Mark · Four clear, and a sore ankle
beats.text: Thirteen points, three clear teams in San Francisco, Baltimore and Chicago, and only the Raiders dropping one. The thing to watch is Lamar Jackson's ankle from Week 4 — Baltimore plays Sunday night in Atlanta against Brian, which is the closest thing to a title fight this week has.

beats.tag: Bill · A point he can't lose, finally
beats.text: Tampa at Dallas on Thursday is his own civil war, the first of his season, and he has needed one: the Bengals have lost two straight and the Buccaneers are 0-4 with Jalon Daniels standing in for Mayfield's thumb. One point banked, no bragging rights, and a roster that needs more than that.

Bye weeks start, so there are fifteen games instead of sixteen and fifteen points to share. The ones that move the table: Indianapolis at Pittsburgh with Jon and Patrick level on nine, San Francisco at Seattle between the top two rosters in the league, and Baltimore at Atlanta on Sunday night.
